name: Esix, Fractal Bloom
oracle_text:
Flying
The first time you would create one or more tokens during each of your turns, you may instead choose a creature other than Esix and create that many tokens that are copies of that creature.
blocked_sentences: The first time you would create one or more tokens during each of your turns, you may instead choose a creature other than Esix and create that many tokens that are copies of that creature

needs.what: an optional replacement of token creation under your control that, instead of the printed tokens, has you choose a creature other than the source (any controller) and creates that many tokens that are copies of it (token count kept, identity replaced by a copy of the chosen creature)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_token_creation's create_instead only substitutes fixed token ids from token_ids; it cannot name a copy of a creature chosen at replacement time, offers no 'you may' choice, and copy_permanent is an op, not something a replacement can substitute for the created tokens

needs.what: a per-turn limit on a replacement static: it applies only to the first token-creation event during each of your turns (and that event consumes it whether or not the optional replacement is taken)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: first_during_your_turn exists only on ability_cost_reduction (the loader refuses it elsewhere), and static_max_per_turn / max_per_turn are trigger or other-static rate limits, not a 'first time you would create tokens during your turn' window on replace_token_creation
